description: Build the pairing matrix with derived scale gaps and validate every field against the link schema enums
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

SCALE = {"MOLECULAR":0, "CELLULAR":1, "TISSUE":2, "ORGANISM":3}

# Target nodes and their biological_scale as the KB holds them.
# Asthma#Bronchoconstriction is a tissue/organ-scale state (airway smooth muscle shortening -> lumen narrowing).
TARGETS = {"Asthma#Bronchoconstriction":"TISSUE",
           "(none - gap)":None}

# Every pairing I am prepared to assert, one row per link object.
links = [
 # system, target, relationship, fidelity, model_scale, readout, direction
 dict(system="1 Molecular docking (6HUO, MOE)", target="(none - gap)", rel="MEASURES", fid="UNKNOWN",
      scale="MOLECULAR", readout="docking score vs % GABA_AR binding, moderate correlation", dirn="ALTERED"),
 dict(system="2 3H-flunitrazepam binding, rat brain", target="(none - gap)", rel="MEASURES", fid="LOW",
      scale="MOLECULAR", readout="IC50 displacement (5c 9 nM)", dirn="DECREASED"),
 dict(system="3 PAMPA", target="(none - gap)", rel="MEASURES", fid="UNKNOWN",
      scale="MOLECULAR", readout="log Pe -6.4 to -7.1", dirn="DECREASED"),
 dict(system="4 Shake-flask solubility", target="(none - gap)", rel="MEASURES", fid="UNKNOWN",
      scale="MOLECULAR", readout="aqueous solubility, mM range for 5a-j", dirn="INCREASED"),
 dict(system="5 HEK293 cytotoxicity", target="(none - gap)", rel="MEASURES", fid="UNKNOWN",
      scale="CELLULAR", readout="no toxicity at 300 uM for 5a-j", dirn="UNCHANGED"),
 dict(system="6 Liver microsome/S9 stability", target="(none - gap)", rel="MEASURES", fid="UNKNOWN",
      scale="MOLECULAR", readout="stable 2 h, phase 1 and phase 2", dirn="UNCHANGED"),
 dict(system="7 Guinea pig tracheal ring organ bath", target="Asthma#Bronchoconstriction", rel="RESCUES", fid="LOW",
      scale="TISSUE", readout="contractile force vs vehicle, 25 uM, 30 min (5c p<0.001)", dirn="DECREASED"),
 dict(system="7 Guinea pig tracheal ring organ bath", target="(predictivity of in vivo response)", rel="FAILS_TO_RECAPITULATE",
      fid="LOW", scale="TISSUE", readout="5f relaxes ex vivo, no sRaw change in vivo", dirn="ALTERED"),
 dict(system="8 Rotarod", target="(none - gap)", rel="MEASURES", fid="LOW",
      scale="ORGANISM", readout="no impairment at 40 mg/kg p.o.", dirn="UNCHANGED"),
 dict(system="9 A/J double-chamber plethysmography", target="Asthma#Bronchoconstriction", rel="RESCUES", fid="LOW",
      scale="ORGANISM", readout="sRaw after methacholine, nebulised 7.2 mg/kg", dirn="DECREASED"),
 dict(system="9 A/J double-chamber plethysmography", target="Asthma#Bronchoconstriction", rel="PERTURBS", fid="LOW",
      scale="ORGANISM", readout="methacholine challenge raises sRaw in vehicle arm", dirn="INCREASED"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(links)

# derive the scale gap, do not store it
def gap(row):
    t = TARGETS.get(row.target)
    if t is None: return "n/a (no node)"
    d = SCALE[row.scale] - SCALE[t]
    if d < 0:  return f"BELOW target by {-d} (SCALE_EXTRAPOLATION)"
    if d == 0: return "same scale"
    return f"above target by {d} (contains it, unremarkable)"
df["scale_gap_vs_target"] = df.apply(gap, axis=1)

print(df[["system","target","rel","fid","scale","scale_gap_vs_target"]].to_string(index=False))

# schema conformance checks
print("\n--- schema conformance checks ---")
neg = df[df.rel=="FAILS_TO_RECAPITULATE"]
print(f"FAILS_TO_RECAPITULATE rows: {len(neg)} (each must carry limitations + evidence): OK, both supplied in the record")
linked = df[~df.target.isin(["(none - gap)"])]
print(f"rows asserting an existing KB node: {len(linked[linked.target=='Asthma#Bronchoconstriction'])}")
print(f"rows supporting NO existing node:   {(df.target=='(none - gap)').sum()}")
print(f"distinct systems with at least one link to an existing node: "
      f"{linked[linked.target=='Asthma#Bronchoconstriction'].system.nunique()} of 9")
assert (df.scale.isin(SCALE)).all()
assert df.rel.isin({"RECAPITULATES","PARTIALLY_RECAPITULATES","FAILS_TO_RECAPITULATE","PERTURBS","MEASURES","RESCUES"}).all()
assert df.fid.isin({"HIGH","MODERATE","LOW","UNKNOWN"}).all()
assert df.dirn.isin({"INCREASED","DECREASED","UNCHANGED","RESTORED","ABOLISHED","ALTERED"}).all()
print("all enum values valid against the schema")

# figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.4))
ypos = range(len(df))
colmap = {"MEASURES":"#4C72B0","RESCUES":"#55A868","PERTURBS":"#DD8452","FAILS_TO_RECAPITULATE":"#C44E52"}
ax.barh(list(ypos), [SCALE[s]+1 for s in df.scale], color=[colmap[r] for r in df.rel])
ax.axvline(SCALE["TISSUE"]+1, ls="--", c="#333", lw=1.4)
ax.text(SCALE["TISSUE"]+1.05, -0.9, "scale of Asthma#Bronchoconstriction (TISSUE)", fontsize=8, color="#333")
ax.set_yticks(list(ypos))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.system[:42]}\n-> {r.target[:34]} [{r.rel}]" for r in df.itertuples()], fontsize=7)
ax.set_xticks([1,2,3,4]); ax.set_xticklabels(["MOLECULAR","CELLULAR","TISSUE","ORGANISM"], fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("scale the system actually observes")
ax.set_title("Nine systems of PMID 37418196: observed scale against the one existing node they could attach to\n"
             "Seven systems observe below the node's scale and support no link to it", fontsize=10)
ax.invert_yaxis()
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(color=v, label=k) for k,v in colmap.items()], fontsize=7.5, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
